title: Enumeration of free coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $0,\\ldots,n-1$. The $i$-th coordinate in the enumeration of the coordinates outside $P$ is the coordinate represented by index $i$, for $i$ ranging from zero to one less than the number of coordinates outside $P$.
